visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses, a white T-shirt, and black shorts walks through an outdoor residential street. He enters a store filled with traditional joss paper and red festive decorations. (2) Inside the store, the man approaches a counter and speaks with a male shop owner who is wearing a black hoodie with 'CHAUWAN' printed on it. The shop is brightly lit with shelves full of golden and red religious items. (3) The shop owner places three cardboard-wrapped packs of Mine-Shine milk tea on the glass counter with a firm hand gesture. The camera zooms in on the product. (4) The scene shifts to a colorful temple background. The shop owner holds up a smartphone showing a colorful mobile website interface featuring red and yellow graphics and a lottery spin wheel. (5) Close-up shots of the phone screen display a text-heavy blessing card addressed 'To 大蛇丸' (Big Snake Ball) with yellow backgrounds. (6) Both men are seen standing in a traditional Chinese temple courtyard. The shop owner gestures enthusiastically while the young man looks surprised and holds his phone. (7) A vibrant yellow graphic background appears with animated 8-bit style elements, showcasing different flavors of Mine-Shine milk tea. (8) The two men walk away from the camera in the temple courtyard, each drinking from a Mine-Shine milk tea box through a straw.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration starts over a bouncy, synthesized pop beat. Sound of footsteps on pavement is audible. (2) The scene transitions with a subtle whoosh as the dialogue moves indoors; voices exhibit slight room reverb. (3) A sharp, percussive thud occurs when the milk tea packs hit the counter, synced with a visual zoom. (4) The shop owner's voice rises in pitch and intensity, delivering a fast-paced promotional script. (5) A 'ding' sound effect mimicking a digital slot machine win plays as the phone screen is shown. (6) A musical stinger with a bright synthesizer chime marks a comedic moment when the creator is 'surprised'. (7) The BGM transitions into a more melodic pop song with female 'Together Forever' lyrics as the two men walk and drink. (8) Final graphic sequence features upbeat, higher volume BGM and a closing slogan delivered in unison.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Creative Solution/Product Reveal -> Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Mine-Shine (麥香) New Year 2025 campaign. The video uses a play on words (the Chinese character for incense is '香', which is also the 'Shine' in the brand name) to humorously suggest that the milk tea is a better offering for good luck than traditional incense. It aims to encourage viewers to use the online blessing interface to win prizes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is centered around the Mine-Shine brand, showing the physical product, its new 2025 packaging, and a specific digital promotion campaign.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends local Taiwanese cultural elements (temple worship) with modern influencer comedy to create a relatable and catchy advertisement.
